fit_reason: Whole pontoon boat with trailer listed in the boats by owner section by a private seller.
findings: Maroon side panels along the port and starboard rails look glossy and clean
Aluminum pontoon tubes look bright and even, with no visible waterline scum or staining
Beige vinyl seating throughout the deck looks clean with no visible stains or mildew
Deck carpet/flooring looks clean and uncluttered
Mercury outboard cowling looks clean and glossy
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 2021 Starcraft LX22R. It already shows really well, with clean seats and bright tubes. If you'd like a quick pre-sale wash, wax and vinyl wipe-down to keep it looking that way for buyers, we can come to you. Would you like a quote?
